comparator.name: Biology
comparator.sourceNotes: The current programme totals 180 EC. The first year is a broad 60-EC biology foundation. The selected Molecular Life Sciences major contributes a 60-EC second year. Year 3 contains a genuine 30-EC minor, three permitted 5-EC Molecular Life Sciences choices including the required option-group choice, and a 15-EC research project. The discontinued Integrative Biology major is not used.

routeSelection.basis: The generic target names no major. Integrative Biology is explicitly discontinued for cohorts from 2025 onward. The four current majors are all specialist routes and none is clearly more general, so the first-listed current route, Molecular Life Sciences, is selected independently of UCR fit.

alternatives.label: Molecular, cellular & biomedical biology
alternatives.labelReason: Molecular cell biology, biochemistry, physiology, genetics, immunity, disease, neuroscience, laboratory work and biological data form the visible spine.
alternatives.concept: The closest feasible response to the selected Molecular Life Sciences major, combining molecular and cellular biology, biochemistry, physiology, genetics, immunity, disease, laboratory work, neuroscience and computational analysis.
progression: Life-science, programming, mathematics and laboratory foundations precede molecular biology, physiology, genetics, disease mechanisms, immunity, neuroscience and advanced data analysis. All prerequisites and offerings pass; eight 300-level courses are included.

alternatives.label: Ecology, evolution & conservation biology
alternatives.labelReason: Biodiversity, ecology, evolution, conservation, climate, marine biology, biogeochemistry and field-linked environmental research dominate the schedule.
alternatives.concept: An ecology-and-evolution route organised around biodiversity, organisms, ecosystems, conservation, climate change, marine life and field-linked environmental research.
progression: Biology, ecology, sustainability and quantitative foundations precede conservation, farming, marine biology, environmental biogeochemistry and partner-linked research. All prerequisites and offerings pass; seven 300-level courses are included.
alternatives.distinctness: This route replaces most molecular, biomedical and neuroscience depth with ecology, biodiversity, climate and environmental systems. It differs from the closest programme by well over 30 EC.

alternatives.label: Behaviour, brain & biological health
alternatives.labelReason: Neurobiology, behaviour, perception, cognition, development, mental health and disease are integrated with molecular and physiological biology and experimental methods.
alternatives.concept: A behaviour-and-health biology route connecting molecular and physiological mechanisms with brain function, perception, cognition, development, disease, mental health and experimental research.
progression: Life-science, brain-and-behaviour, data and philosophical foundations precede physiology, experimental methods, disease, perception, health psychology and advanced cognition. All prerequisites and offerings pass; eight 300-level courses are included.
alternatives.distinctness: This route shifts the organising centre from molecular life science and ecosystems to brain, behaviour and biological health. It clears the 30-EC floor against each earlier programme.

selection.assessment: The selected Molecular Life Sciences route supports a strong molecular and biomedical closest response. Ecology/evolution and behaviour/neuroscience are separately evidenced by current formal majors and target-specific interests, produce substantively different curricula and pass pairwise mechanical distinctness. Production stops at three alternatives.

notes.text: Groningen Biology provides a dedicated Molecular Life Sciences sequence in microbiology, structural biology, microscopy, enzymology, omics and laboratory research. UCR covers molecular, biomedical, ecological and behavioural biology but does not reproduce that specialist sequence or its 15-EC major research project.
